images.filename: Indian cattle sale held at the Fort Hall stockyards - NARA - 298561.jpg
images.caption: Scope and content:  Records of the Extension and Credit Office whose purpose was to work with reservation agricultural and home extension agents to help Indians become self-sufficient and raise living standards. After 1934, credit agents worked with men from the Organization Division in establisheing tribal corporations which were eligible for government loans for development projects.
